Game Overview

In Cut The Rope: Time Travel, the core idea is straightforward: journey through time with Om Nom in Cut The Rope: Time Travel. Solve puzzling physics-based challenges by snipping ropes to feed not one, but two hungry creatures. Navigate historical settings, acclimate to unique gameplay dynamics, and relish the sweet adventure while tackling delightful, mind-bending puzzles.
